request: The Irving–Williams series predicts that the stability of high-spin divalent first-row complexes rises to a maximum at Cu(II) and falls at Zn(II). State this as a falsifiable hypothesis for the 1:1 M(II)-glycine complex, then test it: compute speciation for Co(II), Ni(II), Cu(II) and Zn(II) at 1 mM metal / 10 mM glycine, pH 7, 25 C, I=0.1 m, rank them by the free [M2+] suppressed, and state whether the computed ordering confirms or violates Irving–Williams.
